experiment: WG-4 — COMMITMENT DECOMPOSITION + NEGATIVE META-SOURCE PROOF
model: claude-opus-5[1m], six fresh-context blind subagent calls
inputs: frozen WG-3A extraction (hashes identical to WG-3B input), frozen source, frozen articles, GOLD V2.1 unchanged

WG-4A.name: COMMITMENT DECOMPOSITION
WG-4A.why_the_two_were_not_flagged: Both WERE isolated as their own SOURCE_META commitment (P22-C1, P21-C1) and independently verdicted — so decomposition did its job. WG-4A's verdict step then judged them SUPPORTED / INTERPRETATION via the absence-as-evidence move. WG-4A was deliberately NOT given the negative-source proof rule; that mechanism is WG-4B's, which recovers both. The failing component here is not decomposition.

G13-02.base: 'The person it is happening to did not know the work existed.' -> SUPPORTED
G13-02.modifier: 'That state of not knowing held one hour earlier.' [TEMPORAL_MODIFIER] -> UNSUPPORTED

GR3-01.base: 'The name was not previously known to the visitor.' -> SUPPORTED
GR3-01.modifier: 'That unfamiliarity held as of one hour earlier.' [TEMPORAL_MODIFIER] -> UNSUPPORTED

WG-4A.support_transfer_blocked: Confirmed. In both interval cases the grounded base kept SUPPORTED while the attached modifier was independently judged UNSUPPORTED. The WG-3B entailment-absorption failure does not recur.
WG-4A.false_fragmentation_detail: Every legitimate comparative and causal interpretation emitted exactly ONE commitment: G13-03 (P43-C1 OTHER), GR2-03 (P48-C1 OTHER), GR3-02 comparative (P41-C1 OTHER) and GR3-02 causal (P42-C1 CAUSAL_RELATION) — all INTERPRETATION. 208 of 236 parents produced a single commitment. Analysis was not shredded into fake factual atoms.

WG-4B.name: NEGATIVE META-SOURCE PROOF

G13-04.scope: Would have to be the entire review, since ranking and grouping can be implicit, distributed or carried by evaluative tone.

GR2-02.scope: Would require the whole review: ranking, preference and elevation can be carried implicitly by tone, space, ordering and evaluative adjectives.

R3_control.scope: Every occurrence of the quantity in the source plus its containing passage; the figure occurs exactly once.
R3_control.why_scope_complete: Finite and enumerable rather than scanned — any commentary on the figure would have to sit in the sentence containing it or the sentences around it.

WG-4B.generalisation_check: The discrimination is not example-matching. The prompt used ranking as its unboundable example and quantity-commentary as its boundable one. Of the 6 negative claims that KEPT support, 5 are claims the prompt never illustrated — including R2/P79 'What it does not describe, and cannot', which earned BOUNDED_ABSENCE by enumerating the discovery word-family occurrences itself, and four EXPLICIT proofs scoped to the source's own biographical statements.
WG-4B.divergence_recorded: R2/P79 is a GOLD V2.1 UNCERTAIN item and WG-4B called it SUPPORTED. Not a false positive under the gate, which counts wrongly-UNSUPPORTED verdicts, and gold's uncertainty there derives from GR2-04's dropped qualifier rather than from negative proof. Recorded, not adjudicated — Gold V2.1 was not touched.

combined_coverage_ARITHMETIC_ONLY_NOT_A_.caveat: Arithmetic over two SEPARATE frozen runs. NOT a measured combined configuration and NOT a proposal. WG-3 already demonstrated that a change fixing one mechanism can regress another: WG-3B recovered GR2-01 and simultaneously lost G13-02 and GR3-01. A combined prompt must be measured, not assumed.

overall.next: WG-5 composition is now authorised by the pre-registered criteria, but was NOT built in this task.
